result.summary: Independent audit (round 1, seed 808) completed per rules.md §3/§4/§5. Read only the permitted files (rules.md, missions.yaml, corr_1.md/json, loc.md, operator source in partura/ops_ext.py and AlphaCube-steering/src/alphacube/operators/*); did not read analysis.md/lit.md/notebook.md. No prior rounds existed to read. Applied the real §3 deterministic auto-strike rule (ρ_head≥0.7 or ρ_control≥0.8) directly from corr_1.json raw numbers, since the table's own 'gate' column is a different coverage/distinct data-quality check (from c05_locate.py/diagnose.py), not the correlation rule. Verified operator correctness (NaN-safety, division guards, no lookahead, tie-breaking) by reading source for day_wmean/day_wstd/day_corr/day_topw_mean/in_delay/cross_ema/cs_rank/cs_bucket_rank/cs_bucket_demean/ts_argmax/ts_quantile/cross_tail_mean_q25/q75. Key judgment call: two rows flagged 'gate: false/废品' (slot a seed 10, R4 variant 7, both ts_argmax-based) were traced to common.py's rank() using stable argsort (ties broken by array/stock-column order) combined with ts_argmax's inherent ≤120-148 discrete levels vs ~5220 stocks — this matches rules §4's explicit exemption ('并列靠股票列序打破... 不是问题'), so it was NOT used as a math-trap strike reason. Wrote audit_1.yaml: slot a (E) novelty=4 soundness=4, struck seeds 4/6/11 (ρ_head 0.808/0.725/0.755 ≥ the 0.7 auto-cut), 10 seeds remain, core-vs-control all <0.8 → passes. Slot b (N) novelty=5 soundness=4, no strikes (max ρ_head 0.57, max control ρ 0.571) → passes. Four R groups all soundness=4, with R1 flagged for a citation discrepancy (why-text cites ρ_head=0.695 vs the actual corr_1.json value 0.823 against the head being replaced — doesn't change the replace-vs-new-head outcome under §2's rule, but should be corrected in the next PI pass). File validated as parseable YAML via yaml.safe_load after writing.
